Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly identify the director of "Poker In Bed" in its initial search (Step 4). It reported the director as "Giovanni Carnimee," which is incorrect. The actual director of the 1974 film "Poker in Bed" (original title: *La signora gioca bene a scopa?*) is **Sergio Corbucci**, not Giovanni Carnimee. This error propagated through the rest of the conversation, leading the Planner to incorrectly conclude that Giovanni Carnimee was the director and subsequently fail to find his death date because the name was wrong. The WebSurfer's search results clearly showed "Director: Giovanni Carnimee" in the visible text, but this was a hallucination or misinterpretation of the search engine's auto-completion or a different film entry, as no such director exists in major film databases for this specific title.
